name: Build a conveyor belt
description: Industrial conveyor belt with rotating rollers, side rails, and motor housing. Transports materials between stations in factory and assembly line environments.
luau_source:
-- Conveyor Belt — roller transport system
local function buildConveyor(center, length)
  local m = Instance.new("Model")
  m.Name = "ConveyorBelt"
  -- Belt surface
  local belt = Instance.new("Part")
  belt.Name = "BeltSurface"
  belt.Size = Vector3.new(length, 0.5, 6)
  belt.Position = center + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
  belt.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really black")
  belt.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
  belt.Anchored = true
  belt.Parent = m
  -- Side rails
  for _, side in ipairs({-3.5, 3.5}) do
    local rail = Instance.new("Part")
    rail.Name = "Rail_" .. side
    rail.Size = Vector3.new(length, 1, 0.5)
    rail.Position = center + Vector3.new(0, 3, side)
    rail.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Rust")
    rail.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
    rail.Anchored = true
    rail.Parent = m
  end
  -- Legs
  for i = 0, math.floor(length / 8) do
    for _, side in ipairs({-3, 3}) do
      local leg = Instance.new("Part")
      leg.Name = "Leg"
      leg.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 3, 0.5)
      leg.Position = center + Vector3.new(-length/2 + i * 8, 1.5, side)
      leg.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
      leg.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
      leg.Anchored = true
      leg.Parent = m
    end
  end
  -- Rollers (decorative)
  for i = 0, math.floor(length / 3) do
    local roller = Instance.new("Part")
    roller.Name = "Roller_" .. i
    roller.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    roller.Size = Vector3.new(5, 1, 1)
    roller.CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(-length/2 + i * 3, 2.8, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
    roller.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Medium stone grey")
    roller.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
    roller.Anchored = true
    roller.Parent = m
  end
  return m
end
return buildConveyor

name: Build a rope bridge
description: A swaying rope bridge with wooden planks, rope railings, and frayed edges. Spans gaps between cliffs or platforms with an adventurous feel.
luau_source:
-- Rope Bridge — plank walkway with rope rails
local function buildRopeBridge(startPos, endPos)
  local m = Instance.new("Model")
  m.Name = "RopeBridge"
  local dist = (endPos - startPos).Magnitude
  local direction = (endPos - startPos).Unit
  local planks = math.floor(dist / 2)
  for i = 0, planks do
    local t = i / planks
    local pos = startPos:Lerp(endPos, t)
    -- Sag effect
    local sag = math.sin(t * math.pi) * -1.5
    pos = pos + Vector3.new(0, sag, 0)
    local plank = Instance.new("Part")
    plank.Name = "Plank_" .. i
    plank.Size = Vector3.new(6, 0.5, 2)
    plank.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos, endPos)
    plank.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Redwood")
    plank.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
    plank.Anchored = true
    plank.Parent = m
  end
  -- Rope rails (2 sides)
  for _, side in ipairs({-3, 3}) do
    for i = 0, planks, 2 do
      local t = i / planks
      local pos = startPos:Lerp(endPos, t)
      local sag = math.sin(t * math.pi) * -1.5
      local post = Instance.new("Part")
      post.Name = "RopePost"
      post.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 4, 0.3)
      post.Position = pos + Vector3.new(side, 2, 0) + Vector3.new(0, sag, 0)
      post.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Brown")
      post.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
      post.Anchored = true
      post.Parent = m
    end
  end
  return m
end
return buildRopeBridge

name: Build a crystal cluster
description: A cluster of glowing crystals emerging from rocky ground. Provides fantasy lighting and collectible aesthetic. Multiple crystal shapes with neon glow.
luau_source:
-- Crystal Cluster — glowing fantasy formations
local function buildCrystals(center, count)
  local m = Instance.new("Model")
  m.Name = "CrystalCluster"
  local colors = { "Cyan", "Magenta", "Lime green", "Lily white", "Hot pink" }
  -- Rocky base
  local base = Instance.new("Part")
  base.Name = "CrystalBase"
  base.Size = Vector3.new(6, 2, 6)
  base.Position = center + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
  base.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
  base.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
  base.Anchored = true
  base.Parent = m
  for i = 1, count or 7 do
    local height = 3 + math.random() * 6
    local angle = (i / (count or 7)) * math.pi * 2 + math.random() * 0.5
    local radius = math.random() * 2
    local crystal = Instance.new("Part")
    crystal.Name = "Crystal_" .. i
    crystal.Size = Vector3.new(1 + math.random(), height, 1 + math.random())
    crystal.Position = center + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, height / 2 + 1, math.sin(angle) * radius)
    crystal.CFrame = crystal.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 20), 0, math.rad((math.random() - 0.5) * 20))
    crystal.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(colors[math.random(#colors)])
    crystal.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    crystal.Anchored = true
    crystal.Parent = m
    local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
    light.Color = crystal.Color
    light.Range = 10
    light.Brightness = 1.5
    light.Parent = crystal
  end
  return m
end
return buildCrystals

name: Build a cave entrance
description: A natural rock cave mouth with jagged stone edges, stalactites, and dark interior. Leads to underground areas. Mystery and exploration energy.
luau_source:
-- Cave Entrance — jagged rock mouth

  local m = Instance.new("Model")
  m.Name = "CaveEntrance"
  -- Dark interior
  local interior = Instance.new("Part")
  interior.Name = "Interior"

  interior.Anchored = true

    rock.Size = Vector3.new(size, size + math.random() * 3, size)

    rock.Parent = m

    stal.Anchored = true

  end
  return m

return buildCave

name: Build a mushroom grove
description: A cluster of oversized fantasy mushrooms with glowing caps and spotted stems. Whimsical forest decoration for fairy-tale and alien biomes.
luau_source:
-- Mushroom Grove — oversized glowing fungi
local function buildMushrooms(center, count)
  local m = Instance.new("Model")
  m.Name = "MushroomGrove"
  local capColors = { "Bright red", "Bright blue", "Magenta", "Lime green", "Hot pink" }
  for i = 1, count or 6 do
    local scale = 0.8 + math.random() * 1.5
    local offset = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 16, 0, (math.random() - 0.5) * 16)
    -- Stem
    local stem = Instance.new("Part")
    stem.Name = "Stem_" .. i
    stem.Size = Vector3.new(1.5 * scale, 5 * scale, 1.5 * scale)
    stem.Position = center + offset + Vector3.new(0, 2.5 * scale, 0)
    stem.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Institutional white")
    stem.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    stem.Anchored = true
    stem.Parent = m
    -- Cap
    local cap = Instance.new("Part")
    cap.Name = "Cap_" .. i
    cap.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    cap.Size = Vector3.new(5 * scale, 3 * scale, 5 * scale)
    cap.Position = stem.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3 * scale, 0)
    cap.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(capColors[math.random(#capColors)])
    cap.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    cap.Anchored = true
    cap.Parent = m
    -- Glow
    local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
    light.Color = cap.Color
    light.Range = 8 * scale
    light.Brightness = 1.5
    light.Parent = cap
  end
  return m
end
return buildMushrooms

name: Build a chasm bridge
description: A narrow stone bridge spanning a bottomless chasm with broken railings and ominous fog. Dramatic traversal set-piece for adventure maps.
luau_source:
-- Chasm Bridge — narrow span with broken rails
local function buildChasmBridge(startPos, length)
  local m = Instance.new("Model")
  m.Name = "ChasmBridge"
  -- Main span
  local span = Instance.new("Part")
  span.Name = "BridgeSpan"
  span.Size = Vector3.new(4, 1, length)
  span.Position = startPos + Vector3.new(0, 0, length / 2)
  span.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
  span.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
  span.Anchored = true
  span.Parent = m
  -- Broken railings (some missing)
  for i = 0, math.floor(length / 4) do
    -- Randomly skip some rails for "broken" look
    if math.random() > 0.3 then
      for _, side in ipairs({-2, 2}) do
        local post = Instance.new("Part")
        post.Name = "Railing"
        post.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 3, 0.5)
        post.Position = startPos + Vector3.new(side, 2, i * 4)
        post.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Stone grey")
        post.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
        post.Anchored = true
        post.Parent = m
      end
    end
  end
  -- Fog (translucent parts below)
  for i = 0, 3 do
    local fog = Instance.new("Part")
    fog.Name = "Fog_" .. i
    fog.Size = Vector3.new(10, 8, length * 0.7)
    fog.Position = startPos + Vector3.new(0, -10 - i * 3, length / 2)
    fog.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Institutional white")
    fog.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
    fog.Transparency = 0.8
    fog.Anchored = true
    fog.CanCollide = false
    fog.Parent = m
  end
  return m
end
return buildChasmBridge

name: Build a greenhouse
description: A glass-walled greenhouse with wooden frame, planting tables, and hanging plants. Protected cultivation space for botanical gameplay.
luau_source:
-- Greenhouse — glass walls with plant tables
local function buildGreenhouse(center)
  local m = Instance.new("Model")
  m.Name = "Greenhouse"
  local w, h, d = 16, 8, 12
  -- Glass walls
  for _, face in ipairs({
    { Vector3.new(w, h, 0.5), Vector3.new(0, h/2, d/2) },
    { Vector3.new(w, h, 0.5), Vector3.new(0, h/2, -d/2) },
    { Vector3.new(0.5, h, d), Vector3.new(w/2, h/2, 0) },
    { Vector3.new(0.5, h, d), Vector3.new(-w/2, h/2, 0) },
  }) do
    local wall = Instance.new("Part")
    wall.Name = "GlassWall"
    wall.Size = face[1]
    wall.Position = center + face[2]
    wall.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Deep blue")
    wall.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
    wall.Transparency = 0.6
    wall.Anchored = true
    wall.Parent = m
  end
  -- Wooden frame corners
  for _, x in ipairs({-w/2, w/2}) do
    for _, z in ipairs({-d/2, d/2}) do
      local post = Instance.new("Part")
      post.Name = "FramePost"
      post.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, h, 0.5)
      post.Position = center + Vector3.new(x, h/2, z)
      post.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Redwood")
      post.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
      post.Anchored = true
      post.Parent = m
    end
  end
  -- Roof
  local roof = Instance.new("Part")
  roof.Name = "Roof"
  roof.Size = Vector3.new(w + 1, 0.5, d + 1)
  roof.Position = center + Vector3.new(0, h, 0)
  roof.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Redwood")
  roof.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
  roof.Anchored = true
  roof.Parent = m
  -- Planting tables (2 rows)
  for _, z in ipairs({-3, 3}) do
    local table = Instance.new("Part")
    table.Name = "PlantTable"
    table.Size = Vector3.new(w - 4, 1, 3)
    table.Position = center + Vector3.new(0, 2, z)
    table.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Pine Cone")
    table.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
    table.Anchored = true
    table.Parent = m
    -- Pots on table
    for i = 0, 4 do
      local pot = Instance.new("Part")
      pot.Name = "Pot_" .. z .. "_" .. i
      pot.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1.5, 1)
      pot.Position = center + Vector3.new(-w/2 + 3 + i * 3, 3.25, z)
      pot.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Rust")
      pot.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
      pot.Anchored = true
      pot.Parent = m
      -- Plant
      local plant = Instance.new("Part")
      plant.Name = "Plant_" .. z .. "_" .. i
      plant.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
      plant.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
      plant.Position = pot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.25, 0)
      plant.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Forest green")
      plant.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
      plant.Anchored = true
      plant.Parent = m
    end
  end
  return m
end
return buildGreenhouse
